The brightly coloured buildings are getting another coat of paint. The choir rehearses. Hundreds of other residents, several of them using wheelchairs, practise their positions outside the sanctuary. A German team is visiting for the first time to continue a tradition honouring the Christmas truce. On Christmas Day 1914, British and German troops at several locations in Belgium stopped fighting and came out of their trenches to meet each other. A soldier from Newark, William Setchfield, was present at one near the village of Messines and may even have provided the football which was used during the truce. For the centenary of the event, a team from Newark played a side from its twin town of Emmendingen at the site of the front lines. Now, the two sides will meet again on Saturday in what is being billed as a Peace Match.

Wondering how rain-affected matches are decided in cricket? How the DLS method works in ODIs and T20Is, and how targets are adjusted fairly when weather interrupts play. The DLS method is used to determine fair targets in rain-affected limited-overs matches. The method is exclusively applied to limited-overs formats like ODIs and T20Is and is not used in Test cricket. Many matches, including World Cup games, have been decided by the DLS method, occasionally leading to significant debate. The method's name is derived from its creators Frank Duckworth and Tony Lewis, including the updated inputs from Steven Stern. Which is how the name, Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method was coined.

QB Maddux Risse fooled the Kimball/White Lake defense by acting as if the final lateral was incomplete, then running for the game-tying touchdown. Heath advanced approximately 10 years, then threw a lateral back to Risse (taking a hard hit in the process). From there, Risse tossed a backward pass near the sideline to receiver Rush O'Neill. Downing Street says the prime minister will personally write to councils on Armistice Day to urge them to draw up plans. No one who served in the UK armed forces should have to sleep on the streets this Christmas, Andy Burnham has said. Downing Street said the prime minister will personally write to councils across England on Armistice Day (11 November) to urge them to draw up specific plans to offer accommodation for veterans sleeping rough ahead of the festive period. He will say that, going forward, national and local government should work under the "simple principle" that "no one who has served our country should ever be left to sleep rough on our streets".

The tea is tightly woven into cultures across the region. Here is a look at the history of how that came to be. In places across South Asia, like India and Pakistan, people power their morning — and much of their day — with chai. The tea, boiled in milk with sugar and spices like ginger and cardamom for a version called masala chai, is tightly woven into the culture. Chai has long been a comforting drink there, but its rise across South Asia has a lot to do with a yearslong and expensive marketing campaign, starting with the British.

Woodmont girls volleyball coach Haleigh Horgan's father died before the season started. Her team rallied around her and claimed its second state title. The Woodmont girls volleyball coach vividly recalled last season when the Wildcats defeated North Myrtle Beach in a five-set thriller to claim the school's first state championship in 47 years . Her father, Jimmy Gilbert, occupied that special spot in the bleachers. Before the season started, Gilbert died. And after Woodmont (42-2) defeated Wando (37-7) in four sets (19-25, 25-20, 25-22, 25-22) to win the SCHSL Class 5A state championship on Nov. 7 at Dreher High School, all Horgan could think about was how proud her father would be.

Voters sent National and Labour a clear message last night – and the parties have no one to blame but themselves New Zealand voters sent the two major parties a clear message last night. Unless you have experienced one, it is hard to understand just how physical the symptoms can be – the pounding heart, the shortness of breath, the dizziness, the chest pain, the nausea. The Florida Gators' Week 10 loss to Oklahoma once again sent them tumbling down the Football Power Index rankings, but they remain among the top 30. The FPI measures team strength and is meant to be the best predictor of a team's performance for the rest of the season; it shows how many points above or below average a team is. Each team is assigned a rating that measures its true strength on a net-points scale, as well as its expected point margin against an average opponent on a neutral field. Projected results are based on 20,000 season simulations using FPI and the schedule. Take a look at how Florida 's numbers shake out after Week 10's gridiron action.

Here's a look at BCCI's consent forms and rules for denying a trade and if a player can refuse to be traded to another team. No player in the Indian Premier League (IPL) can be traded without signing a BCCI consent form, and signing is entirely their choice. Trade talks between franchises cannot legally begin until that signed form reaches the BCCI. A player who consents cannot then pick his destination, as the selling franchise chooses the bid. Yes. The consent form sits at the centre of every IPL trade, and a player who declines to sign it cannot be moved, regardless of what the two franchises have agreed between themselves.

Joey Logano says rivals once waited for a young Kyle Larson to hit the wall at Homestead, but that is no longer how the garage sees him. Tee Higgins caught the 50tth touchdown pass of his career in Madrid, then gave the ball to a young fan. His reaction was priceless. Tee Higgins caught a 4-yard touchdown pass from Joe Burrow in the second quarter of the Cincinnati Bengals ' Nov. 8 game against the Atlanta Falcons in Madrid.
